name: unity-agent-template
description: Node scripts for the agent harness only — the game itself lives in unity/.

scripts.verify: npm run --silent check:harness && if command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm run --silent test; else echo 'verify: dotnet SDK 가 없어 Domain 테스트를 건너뛴다 (brew install dotnet)'; fi
